snippet.title: TapRacer – Demo Trailer, New Track | Drag racing where your throttle is two keys
snippet.description:
TapRacer is a side-on drag racer. Tap two keys in strict alternation – how fast you tap is how far the throttle opens. Underneath sits a real longitudinal physics model: torque curves, gear ratios, clutch slip, tire temperature and weight transfer. Launch too low and the engine bogs, too high and the tires break loose – nothing is scripted.

New in this trailer: the rebuilt quarter mile with hills, kerbs and a start arch, and a time trial against a ghost from the online leaderboard.

The free demo is on Steam (Windows): three cars, an eight-race career series, quick race, garage, time trial and online leaderboards.

Free demo / wishlist: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5077320/
Website and press kit: https://tapracer.de
Full release: Q4 2026. No generative AI anywhere in the game.
